title: How is titanium produced The toughest metal on Earth
speaker: GeoDiscovery
zh: 【GeoDiscovery】鈦是如何生產的 地球上最堅硬的金屬（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: 119 years passed between identifying a metal and holding a usable piece of it.
cues.en: 119 years passed between identifying a metal and holding a usable piece of it.
cues.zh: 從識別金屬到拿到一塊可用的金屬，已經過了 119 年。

cues.text: That span, from 1791 to 1910, is the whole problem in miniature.
cues.en: That span, from 1791 to 1910, is the whole problem in miniature.
cues.zh: 從 1791 年到 1910 年這段時間是整個問題的縮影。

cues.text: You have almost certainly touched titanium today.
cues.en: You have almost certainly touched titanium today.
cues.zh: 您今天幾乎肯定接觸過鈦。

cues.text: It is the white stripe on your toothpaste, the white paint on your wall,
cues.en: It is the white stripe on your toothpaste, the white paint on your wall,
cues.zh: 它是你牙膏上的白色條紋，你牆上的白色油漆，

cues.text: and the alloy fan blade inside a jet engine.
cues.en: and the alloy fan blade inside a jet engine.
cues.zh: 以及噴射發動機內的合金風扇葉片。

cues.text: Same element, two completely unrelated worlds.
cues.en: Same element, two completely unrelated worlds.
cues.zh: 相同的元素，兩個完全不相關的世界。

cues.text: By the end of this, you will know exactly how titanium is pulled out of rock,
cues.en: By the end of this, you will know exactly how titanium is pulled out of rock,
cues.zh: 閱讀本文後，您將確切地知道如何從岩石中提取鈦，

cues.text: and why the phrase, the toughest metal on earth, does not survive contact with the evidence.
cues.en: and why the phrase, the toughest metal on earth, does not survive contact with the evidence.
cues.zh: 以及為什麼這個短語“地球上最堅硬的金屬”在與證據接觸後無法倖存。

cues.text: Start with the refusal.
cues.en: Start with the refusal.
cues.zh: 從拒絕開始。

cues.text: Iron surrenders to heat in a blast furnace in hours.
cues.en: Iron surrenders to heat in a blast furnace in hours.
cues.zh: 鐵在高爐中數小時內就會受熱。

cues.text: Titanium does not.
cues.en: Titanium does not.
cues.zh: 鈦則不然。

cues.text: The obvious industrial method, melting the ore with carbon the way you smelt iron, fails outright.
cues.en: The obvious industrial method, melting the ore with carbon the way you smelt iron, fails outright.
cues.zh: 顯而易見的工業方法，即用碳熔化礦石，就像熔煉鐵一樣，徹底失敗了。

cues.text: Carbon reduction readily produces stable titanium carbide.
cues.en: Carbon reduction readily produces stable titanium carbide.
cues.zh: 碳還原容易產生穩定的碳化鈦。

cues.text: So instead of a pool of metal, you get a ceramic brick you cannot work.
cues.en: So instead of a pool of metal, you get a ceramic brick you cannot work.
cues.zh: 因此，您得到的不是一池金屬，而是一塊無法加工的陶瓷磚。

cues.text: The shortcut that built steel is a dead end here.
cues.en: The shortcut that built steel is a dead end here.
cues.zh: 煉鋼的捷徑在這裡是死衚衕。

cues.text: So the industrial route cannot be heat.
cues.en: So the industrial route cannot be heat.
cues.zh: 所以工業路線不可能是熱的。

cues.text: It has to be chemistry.
cues.en: It has to be chemistry.
cues.zh: 它必須是化學。

cues.text: Not fire, but chlorine.
cues.en: Not fire, but chlorine.
cues.zh: 不是火，而是氯。

cues.text: That single constraint explains everything downstream.
cues.en: That single constraint explains everything downstream.
cues.zh: 這個單一的限制解釋了下游的一切。

cues.text: The sealed vessels, the inert atmospheres, the price tag.
cues.en: The sealed vessels, the inert atmospheres, the price tag.
cues.zh: 密封容器、惰性氣氛、價格標籤。

cues.text: Hold that thought, because it also explains something stranger.
cues.en: Hold that thought, because it also explains something stranger.
cues.zh: 保持這個想法，因為它也解釋了一些奇怪的事情。

cues.text: If a metal is this stubborn, who even bothers?
cues.en: If a metal is this stubborn, who even bothers?
cues.zh: 如果金屬如此頑固，誰還會煩惱呢？

cues.text: Back up to the beginning, to a stream in Cornwall in 1791.
cues.en: Back up to the beginning, to a stream in Cornwall in 1791.
cues.zh: 回到起點，1791 年康沃爾郡的一條小溪。

cues.text: An English clergyman and amateur geologist named William Greger was working gravel when he
cues.en: An English clergyman and amateur geologist named William Greger was working gravel when he
cues.zh: 一位名叫威廉·格雷格 (William Greger) 的英國牧師兼業餘地質學家正在開採礫石，當時他

cues.text: noticed black sand that behaved oddly.
cues.en: noticed black sand that behaved oddly.
cues.zh: 注意到黑色的沙子表現得很奇怪。

cues.text: He identified a new element in a mineral found there.
cues.en: He identified a new element in a mineral found there.
cues.zh: 他在那裡發現的一種礦物中發現了一種新元素。

cues.text: In 1795, the German chemist Martin Heinrich Klaproth found the same element independently
cues.en: In 1795, the German chemist Martin Heinrich Klaproth found the same element independently
cues.zh: 1795年，德國化學家馬丁·海因裡希·克拉普羅特獨立發現了同種元素

cues.text: inside Rutel and gave it the name titanium.
cues.en: inside Rutel and gave it the name titanium.
cues.zh: 並把它命名為「鈦」。

cues.text: Identifying a metal and holding it are different things.
cues.en: Identifying a metal and holding it are different things.
cues.zh: 識別金屬和持有它是不同的事情。

cues.text: Identifying it took four years, holding it took 119.
cues.en: Identifying it took four years, holding it took 119.
cues.zh: 識別它花了四年，持有它花了119年。

cues.text: Two independent men, two countries, four years apart, and neither of them ever saw what they
cues.en: Two independent men, two countries, four years apart, and neither of them ever saw what they
cues.zh: 兩個獨立的人，兩個國家，相隔四年，但他們都沒有見過自己所經歷的一切。

cues.text: had found in usable form.
cues.en: had found in usable form.
cues.zh: 已發現可用的形式。

cues.text: They had detected an element the way you detect a shadow through frosted glass.
cues.en: They had detected an element the way you detect a shadow through frosted glass.
cues.zh: 他們檢測到一種元素就像透過毛玻璃檢測陰影一樣。

cues.text: The substance underneath stayed theoretical.
cues.en: The substance underneath stayed theoretical.
cues.zh: 背後的實質內容仍停留在理論層面。

cues.text: The next attempt came in 1910.
cues.en: The next attempt came in 1910.
cues.zh: 下一次嘗試是在 1910 年。

cues.text: M.A. Hunter, working for General Electric in the United States, heated titanium
cues.en: M.A. Hunter, working for General Electric in the United States, heated titanium
cues.zh: M.A. Hunter，在美國通用電氣工作，加熱鈦

cues.text: tetrachloride with sodium inside a sealed vessel under high pressure.
cues.en: tetrachloride with sodium inside a sealed vessel under high pressure.
cues.zh: 在高壓下將四氯化物與鈉放入密封容器中。

cues.text: He reported titanium 99.8% pure.
cues.en: He reported titanium 99.8% pure.
cues.zh: 他報道鈦的純度為 99.8%。

cues.text: That number is remarkable for the era.
cues.en: That number is remarkable for the era.
cues.zh: 這個數字對於那個時代來說是驚人的。

cues.text: Two men, four years apart, and 119 years before anyone could actually hold what they had found.
cues.en: Two men, four years apart, and 119 years before anyone could actually hold what they had found.
cues.zh: 兩個人，相隔四年，距離任何人能夠真正掌握他們所發現的東西已經過去了 119 年。

cues.text: That is the entire arc of this element compressed into a single sentence.
cues.en: That is the entire arc of this element compressed into a single sentence.
cues.zh: 這就是這個元素的整個弧線被壓縮成一個句子。

cues.text: Stay with this channel, because the part of that weight still ahead of you
cues.en: Stay with this channel, because the part of that weight still ahead of you
cues.zh: 留在這個頻道，因為那部分重量仍然在你前面

cues.text: is the part that decides which nations get to fly.
cues.en: is the part that decides which nations get to fly.
cues.zh: 是決定哪些國家可以飛行的部分。

cues.text: And consider this, when Hunter reported titanium at 99.8% pure in 1910,
cues.en: And consider this, when Hunter reported titanium at 99.8% pure in 1910,
cues.zh: 考慮一下這一點，當亨特在 1910 年報道鈦的純度為 99.8% 時，

cues.text: it was still useless at scale.
cues.en: it was still useless at scale.
cues.zh: 就規模而言，它仍然毫無用處。

cues.text: Leave a comment telling me which number stuck with you,
cues.en: Leave a comment telling me which number stuck with you,
cues.zh: 留下評論告訴我哪個號碼讓你印象深刻，

cues.text: the four years it took to name the metal, or the 119 it took to hold it.
cues.en: the four years it took to name the metal, or the 119 it took to hold it.
cues.zh: 為這種金屬命名花了四年時間，或者說，它花了 119 年才被命名。

cues.text: It was also, at industrial scale, useless.
cues.en: It was also, at industrial scale, useless.
cues.zh: 從工業規模來看，它也是毫無用處的。

cues.text: Elegant? Yes.
cues.en: Elegant? Yes.
cues.zh: 優雅的？是的。

cues.text: Reproducible in grams, not tons.
cues.en: Reproducible in grams, not tons.
cues.zh: 可重複以克為單位，而不是噸。

cues.text: To make the metal you needed a vessel that could survive extreme pressure
cues.en: To make the metal you needed a vessel that could survive extreme pressure
cues.zh: 為了製造金屬，您需要一個能夠承受極端壓力的容器

cues.text: and a reducing agent that would not contaminate the result.
cues.en: and a reducing agent that would not contaminate the result.
cues.zh: 以及不會汙染結果的還原劑。

cues.text: And you needed both at once, in quantity.
cues.en: And you needed both at once, in quantity.
cues.zh: 而且您同時需要大量的兩者。

cues.text: Hunter had solved the chemistry.
cues.en: Hunter had solved the chemistry.
cues.zh: 亨特已經解決了化學問題。

cues.text: He had not solved the factory.
cues.en: He had not solved the factory.
cues.zh: 他還沒有解決工廠問題。

cues.text: Then came the man whose name is still attached to the process you are breathing near right now.
cues.en: Then came the man whose name is still attached to the process you are breathing near right now.
cues.zh: 然後是那個人，他的名字仍然與你現在呼吸附近的過程有關。

cues.text: In 1932, William J. Kroll produced significant quantities of ductile titanium in Luxembourg,
cues.en: In 1932, William J. Kroll produced significant quantities of ductile titanium in Luxembourg,
cues.zh: 1932 年，William J. Kroll 在盧森堡生產了大量的延展性鈦，

cues.text: initially using calcium to reduce titanium tetrachloride.
cues.en: initially using calcium to reduce titanium tetrachloride.
cues.zh: 最初用鈣來還原四氯化鈦。

cues.text: By 1938, he had produced 20 kilograms.
cues.en: By 1938, he had produced 20 kilograms.
cues.zh: 到1938年，他已經生產了20公斤。

cues.text: Then he changed the reducing agent to magnesium.
cues.en: Then he changed the reducing agent to magnesium.
cues.zh: 然後他將還原劑改為鎂。

cues.text: And that switch became the basis for most current titanium production.
cues.en: And that switch became the basis for most current titanium production.
cues.zh: 這種轉變成為目前大多數鈦生產的基礎。

cues.text: Twenty kilograms.
cues.en: Twenty kilograms.
cues.zh: 二十公斤。

cues.text: Think about the weight of that.
cues.en: Think about the weight of that.
cues.zh: 想想它的重量。

cues.text: Twenty kilograms fits in a suitcase.
cues.en: Twenty kilograms fits in a suitcase.
cues.zh: 行李箱可以裝二十公斤。

cues.text: It is also the hinge on which an entire global industry turned.
cues.en: It is also the hinge on which an entire global industry turned.
cues.zh: 它也是整個全球產業的樞紐。

cues.text: The recipe now existed.
cues.en: The recipe now existed.
cues.zh: 現在配方已經存在了。

cues.text: The question moved off the chemistry bench and into the reactor hall.
cues.en: The question moved off the chemistry bench and into the reactor hall.
cues.zh: 這個問題從化學實驗臺轉移到了反應爐大廳。

cues.text: Iron melts out of rock in a furnace in hours,
cues.en: Iron melts out of rock in a furnace in hours,
cues.zh: 鐵在熔爐中從岩石中熔化幾個小時，

cues.text: and titanium refuses that path entirely.
cues.en: and titanium refuses that path entirely.
cues.zh: 而鈦則完全拒絕這條道路。

cues.text: Here is why.
cues.en: Here is why.
cues.zh: 這就是原因。

cues.text: It does not surrender to carbon, so it has to be handed over chemically, atom by atom,
cues.en: It does not surrender to carbon, so it has to be handed over chemically, atom by atom,
cues.zh: 它不會屈服於碳，因此必須透過化學方式，逐個原子地進行交接，

cues.text: through a chain of steps that each demand their own conditions.
cues.en: through a chain of steps that each demand their own conditions.
cues.zh: 透過一系列步驟，每個步驟都有自己的條件。

cues.text: That is the answer to the first question your brain asked at the start of this video.
cues.en: That is the answer to the first question your brain asked at the start of this video.
cues.zh: 這是您的大腦在本影片開始時提出的第一個問題的答案。

cues.text: Now watch what that chain actually looks like, because it is longer than anything you would guess.
cues.en: Now watch what that chain actually looks like, because it is longer than anything you would guess.
cues.zh: 現在看看這條鏈條實際上是什麼樣子，因為它比你想像的任何東西都長。

cues.text: Ore goes in first, and the ore is usually ilmenite or rutal.
cues.en: Ore goes in first, and the ore is usually ilmenite or rutal.
cues.zh: 首先進去的是礦石，礦石一般是鈦鐵礦或鐵礦。

cues.text: Dark, heavy grains that look like black sand on a beach.
cues.en: Dark, heavy grains that look like black sand on a beach.
cues.zh: 深色、沉重的顆粒看起來就像海灘上的黑沙。

cues.text: The ore is chlorinated to make titanium tetrachloride,
cues.en: The ore is chlorinated to make titanium tetrachloride,
cues.zh: 礦石經氯化可製得四氯化鈦，

cues.text: a volatile liquid that can be purified by distillation.
cues.en: a volatile liquid that can be purified by distillation.
cues.zh: 可以透過蒸餾純化的揮發性液體。

cues.text: That purification matters more than anything else in the chain,
cues.en: That purification matters more than anything else in the chain,
cues.zh: 這種淨化比鏈條中的其他任何事情都重要，

cues.text: because any iron left inside poisons the final metal.
cues.en: because any iron left inside poisons the final metal.
cues.zh: 因為任何留在裡面的鐵都會使最終的金屬中毒。

cues.text: Chlorine is what does the separating biting through the ore at high temperature,
cues.en: Chlorine is what does the separating biting through the ore at high temperature,
cues.zh: 氯是在高溫下咬穿礦石分離的東西，

cues.text: while the titanium leaves as vapor, and the unwanted metals stay behind.
cues.en: while the titanium leaves as vapor, and the unwanted metals stay behind.
cues.zh: 而鈦則以蒸氣形式留下，不需要的金屬則留下來。

cues.text: Then the purified tetrachloride goes into a sealed vessel under inert argon.
cues.en: Then the purified tetrachloride goes into a sealed vessel under inert argon.
cues.zh: 然後將純化的四氯化物放入惰性氬氣下的密封容器中。

cues.text: And magnesium reduces it.
cues.en: And magnesium reduces it.
cues.zh: 鎂可以減少它。

cues.text: Sealed and inert because air and moisture contaminate the batch,
cues.en: Sealed and inert because air and moisture contaminate the batch,
cues.zh: 密封且呈惰性，因為空氣和濕氣會汙染批次，

cues.text: and contamination is the enemy at every stage.
cues.en: and contamination is the enemy at every stage.
cues.zh: 汙染是每個階段的敵人。

cues.text: Argon is there to keep the reaction clean, not to protect anyone from the heat.
cues.en: Argon is there to keep the reaction clean, not to protect anyone from the heat.
cues.zh: 氬氣的作用是保持反應清潔，而不是保護任何人免受高溫。

cues.text: What comes out is not a gleaming bar.
cues.en: What comes out is not a gleaming bar.
cues.zh: 出來的並不是一個閃閃發光的酒吧。

cues.text: It is a gray, porous lump that looks closer to a sea sponge than to metal,
cues.en: It is a gray, porous lump that looks closer to a sea sponge than to metal,
cues.zh: 它是一種灰色的多孔塊狀物，看起來更接近海綿而不是金屬，

cues.text: warm from the reactor, and almost nobody outside a handful of plants has ever held one.
cues.en: warm from the reactor, and almost nobody outside a handful of plants has ever held one.
cues.zh: 來自反應爐的熱量，除了少數工廠之外，幾乎沒有人擁有過它。

cues.text: That lump is called sponge titanium,
cues.en: That lump is called sponge titanium,
cues.zh: 那個塊狀物叫做海綿鈦，

cues.text: and it is the closest most of the world ever gets to the raw material.
cues.en: and it is the closest most of the world ever gets to the raw material.
cues.zh: 這是世界上最接近原料的地方。

cues.text: Most people have never heard the word sponge titanium,
cues.en: Most people have never heard the word sponge titanium,
cues.zh: 大多數人從未聽過海綿鈦這個詞，

cues.text: much less pictured a gray, porous lump, warm from the reactor,
cues.en: much less pictured a gray, porous lump, warm from the reactor,
cues.zh: 更不用說想像出一個灰色的、多孔的塊狀物，來自反應爐的溫暖，

cues.text: closer to a sea sponge than to metal.
cues.en: closer to a sea sponge than to metal.
cues.zh: 與金屬相比，它更接近海綿。

cues.text: That is exactly the kind of hidden middle this channel exists to open up.
cues.en: That is exactly the kind of hidden middle this channel exists to open up.
cues.zh: 這正是該通道要開啟的那種隱藏的中間部分。

cues.text: The part where chlorine bites through black sand and argon guards a sealed vessel.
cues.en: The part where chlorine bites through black sand and argon guards a sealed vessel.
cues.zh: 氯氣咬穿黑沙的部分和氬氣保護密封容器。

cues.text: So stay with this channel if you want the rest of the chain.
cues.en: So stay with this channel if you want the rest of the chain.
cues.zh: 因此，如果您想要該鏈的其餘部分，請留在該頻道。

cues.text: We are about to melt that lump under vacuum and turn it into the metal inside a jet engine,
cues.en: We are about to melt that lump under vacuum and turn it into the metal inside a jet engine,
cues.zh: 我們將在真空下熔化該塊並將其變成噴氣發動機內的金屬，

cues.text: and the steps still ahead are the ones almost nobody tells you about.
cues.en: and the steps still ahead are the ones almost nobody tells you about.
cues.zh: 前面的步驟幾乎沒有人告訴你。

cues.text: Leave the word sponge titanium in the comments if that image is the one that stuck with you,
cues.en: Leave the word sponge titanium in the comments if that image is the one that stuck with you,
cues.zh: 如果這張圖片讓你印象深刻，請在評論中留下「海綿鈦」這個詞，

cues.text: or tell me which stage of the chain you would never have guessed.
cues.en: or tell me which stage of the chain you would never have guessed.
cues.zh: 或告訴我你永遠猜不到的鏈條的哪個階段。

cues.text: From there, the sponge is packed into an electrode and melted under vacuum.
cues.en: From there, the sponge is packed into an electrode and melted under vacuum.
cues.zh: 從那裡，海綿被裝入電極並在真空下熔化。

cues.text: Again with extreme care, into an ingot,
cues.en: Again with extreme care, into an ingot,
cues.zh: 再次極度小心地製成錠，

cues.text: the whole sequence from ore to usable metal can run for days.
cues.en: the whole sequence from ore to usable metal can run for days.
cues.zh: 從礦石到可用金屬的整個過程可以執行數天。

cues.text: Days of sealed vessels, days of controlled atmospheres, days of enormous electrical load.
cues.en: Days of sealed vessels, days of controlled atmospheres, days of enormous electrical load.
cues.zh: 密封容器的日子、受控氣氛的日子、巨大電力負載的日子。

cues.text: Which raises the obvious question, why pay that price at all?
cues.en: Which raises the obvious question, why pay that price at all?
cues.zh: 這就提出了一個顯而易見的問題：為什麼要付出這樣的代價？

cues.text: In 1946, the US Air Force study identified titanium alloys as potentially important for
cues.en: In 1946, the US Air Force study identified titanium alloys as potentially important for
cues.zh: 1946 年，美國空軍研究發現鈦合金具有潛在的重要用途

cues.text: jet aircraft, precisely because of the need for higher strength-to-weight ratios.
cues.en: jet aircraft, precisely because of the need for higher strength-to-weight ratios.
cues.zh: 噴射機，正是因為需要更高的強度重量比。

cues.text: If you are building something that must fly,
cues.en: If you are building something that must fly,
cues.zh: 如果你正在建造一些必須飛行的東西

cues.text: every kilogram you shave is thrust and fuel recovered.
